caption:
A quick safety briefing for every Supply Drop winner.

Black Point Gaming never DMs winners asking for payment or fees. We only reach out to verify your identity and, for physical prizes, confirm your name and shipping address. Winner communication happens in Discord.

If anyone asks you to pay to claim a prize, it isn't us. Report it to staff.

US only · 18+ · Discord required. Full rules on the website. Black Point Gaming never DMs winners asking for payment or fees.
